CodeWeavers | Toronto, ON, CA | Full Time Contract | On-site | Software Developer Port Jump Team | macOS and Linux development

https://www.codeweavers.com/about/jobs

CodeWeavers is seeking a full-time developer to join our PortJump team. Building on Wine and CrossOver, this developer will help deliver high-quality application ports for both macOS and Linux. Experience in developing, debugging, and testing on macOS and Linux is essential. The ideal candidate will have experience with C, Python, Git, and open-source development.

Please see link above for information, benefits, requirements, and how to apply.

Please direct any questions to the email address on our Jobs page.
